name: Number
label: Number
description: The number to operate on. This can be a number, or a variable containing a number

name: Operation
label: Operation
description: Specifies the operation to perform on the number.

selectOptions.label: Get Integer Part
selectOptions.description: Extracts the integer part of the number.

selectOptions.label: Get Decimal Part
selectOptions.description: Extracts the decimal part of the number.

selectOptions.label: Round Number
selectOptions.description: Rounds the number to a specified number of decimal places.

name: DecimalPlaces
label: Decimal Places
description: The number of decimal places to round to. Required only if the operation is 'RoundNumber'.

name: Result
label: Result
description: Returns the result of the operation.
